subject: Attendance Alert: Action Required - $student_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is an automated notification regarding your attendance in the following module(s):

Module: $module_name
Current Attendance Rate: $attendance_percentage%
Required Minimum: 90%

Your attendance has fallen below the required threshold of 90%. This may affect your academic standing and eligibility for assessments.

Immediate Action Required:
- Review your attendance records
- Contact your module instructor to discuss any extenuating circumstances
- Ensure you attend all upcoming sessions

If you have any medical or personal circumstances affecting your attendance, please contact Student Support Services or submit a formal absence request through the student portal.

Attendance Summary:
$attendance_summary

For more information or to view your detailed attendance record, please log in to the student portal.

Best regards,
$signature
